title: 星空生存STAR MC
description: A server suitable for retirement, simple, warm, and harmonious.
body:
Starry Sky Retirement Survival Version 1.21.8

A Minecraft server created out of sentiment and commitment, it has been around for over 8 years since its inception. There is no magnificent main city here, no amazing buildings, only a group of lovely friends. We just want to create a warm and friendly circle of friends, to protect our memories here. Everyone can chat freely in the group, exchange ideas, and reminisce about the past.

Experience the fun of vanilla survival. We will continuously update and add new gameplay elements. By integrating new gameplay into vanilla survival, we say goodbye to monotony and inject full vitality into the game. MCMMO—this is a skill development system that does not affect the fun of vanilla, increasing the fun of progression. Complete shop system | title system | daily check-in | self-operated shops | unlimited support for automation and mob towers | large-scale construction, retirement, and more fun elements waiting for you to explore~

The server focuses on creating the best visual effects. Server information is set more concisely and aesthetically. The server can handle high-frequency redstone, freeing you to experiment to your heart's content. The server allows high-altitude liquids and constructions, provided they are meaningful and beautiful. Everything we do is to highly restore the fun of survival (please treat it well). The server offers pure survival without any mods, blending a variety of elements. The server's core version is pure 1.21.8, and the group files can be directly downloaded for the client.
